title: asplenium hispanicum
intro: Asplenium hispanicum, commonly known as Iberian Maidenhair Fern, is a species of fern native to the Iberian Peninsula. It is a non-vascular plant that belongs to the family Aspleniaceae and is known for its delicate, lacy fronds. The health benefits of Asplenium hispanicum include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which may exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects.
